serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Hello there. Did you come here to pray, perhaps?
I know he takes his job seriously, but I never showed any intentions of wanting to pray here, so why does he even bother asking?
You: Actually, I came here to ask Shanice something.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Oh.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: She’s at the back, attending to her tasks.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Maybe I can help you instead?
You: Well, it’s not like it’s a secret… {{wi}}or rather, it is a secret, but it wouldn’t hurt for you to know it, if you keep quiet about it.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: As long as it's not anything illegal or sinful, I can keep a secret.
You: It might be a little~ illegal, but only a tiny bit.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: …
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I will go fetch Shanice…
